name: Veridas Communications
summary: Brisbane wholesale ISP (wholesale dialup/ADSL/wireless to ~170 ISP clients); acquired Lithoptix DSL customers 2004; collapsed Sep 2006, receivership Oct 2006, ABN cancelled 2009.

events.details: Business roots 1993 (John Russell); Pty Ltd c.2002.

Collapsed Sep 2006 amid management rift; receivership Oct 2006; ABN cancelled 2009. No single acquirer — ~170 ISP resellers individually migrated customers to People Telecom, Wild IT and other wholesalers.
